title: Sparkly hot air balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloon' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8a5c'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#e8433f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b81f4b'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='skyband' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe07a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb03a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- balloon envelope -->
  <path d='M50 6 C30 6 16 22 16 40 C16 54 26 64 36 68 L64 68 C74 64 84 54 84 40 C84 22 70 6 50 6 Z' fill='url(#balloon)'/>
  <!-- colour panels -->
  <path d='M50 6 C38 6 28 16 24 28 L50 68 Z' fill='#ffcf4a' opacity='0.85'/>
  <path d='M50 6 C62 6 72 16 76 28 L50 68 Z' fill='#ffcf4a' opacity='0.55'/>
  <path d='M50 6 L50 68' stroke='#fff0c0' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- highlight sheen -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='28' rx='9' ry='14' fill='#ffe9d0' opacity='0.35' transform='rotate(-20 36 28)'/>
  <!-- opening at bottom of envelope -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='14' ry='4' fill='#7a1030'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='9' ry='2.2' fill='#ff8a5c' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- rigging lines -->
  <path d='M37 68 L45 78 M63 68 L55 78 M44 69 L48 78 M56 69 L52 78' stroke='#c8a06a' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- basket -->
  <path d='M40 78 L60 78 L57 90 L43 90 Z' fill='#c88a3c'/>
  <path d='M40 78 L60 78 L59 82 L41 82 Z' fill='#e6a95a'/>
  <path d='M44 82 L44 90 M50 82 L50 90 M56 82 L56 90' stroke='#8a5a1e' stroke-width='1.2' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <path d='M14 20 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M86 14 l1.6 4 4 1.6 -4 1.6 -1.6 4 -1.6 -4 -4 -1.6 4 -1.6 z'/>
    <path d='M88 52 l1.4 3.6 3.6 1.4 -3.6 1.4 -1.4 3.6 -1.4 -3.6 -3.6 -1.4 3.6 -1.4 z'/>
    <circle cx='10' cy='48' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='34' r='1.7'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='56' r='1.5'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ffe9a0'>
    <circle cx='90' cy='30' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='6' cy='66' r='1.4'/>
    <path d='M30 12 l1.1 2.8 2.8 1.1 -2.8 1.1 -1.1 2.8 -1.1 -2.8 -2.8 -1.1 2.8 -1.1 z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
